beats.text: In Burundi, women work at 99.1% of the male rate. In Iraq, it is 15.8%.
The labor force is the sum of all persons of working age who are employed and those who are unemployed.
Burundi is one of the highest, with 6.3 times the ratio found in Iraq.
Iraq sits at 15.8%, the world's lowest.
Nigeria at 97.4% and Angola at 98% show nearly balanced participation.
At the bottom, Sudan is 23.3%, Iran is 20.9%, and Iraq is 15.8%.
Which countries see the most balanced workforce participation?
